g.text: Electron and hole drift oppose each other while their conventional currents add

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Low-field homogeneous semiconductor drift model, positive elementary charge q=1.602176634×10⁻¹⁹ C. Example σ≈21.62946 S/m and ρ≈0.046233 Ω·m. Electron
velocity is opposite E but electron conventional current is along E; hole current is also along E. Diffusion, high-field velocity saturation and spatially
varying carrier populations are omitted; mobilities are illustrative fixed values.
